judge.rationale: The candidate only added a definition of done file (`.lore/dod.md`) and a single failing acceptance test file (`src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without writing any production code at all. None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `config.ts`, specs, or documentation were implemented. Because the feature is completely absent, the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately. Furthermore, the test file itself omits key amended requirements from the ticket, such as composite cursor validation for `before` (`{updatedAt, sessionId}`) and `StoreCannotList` error handling.
